title: Integer field extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for a Part 2 integer field (n_groups, signal_lag, min_bonds, holding_period, realisation_min_survivors, hac_lags). The model returns an integer value plus a verbatim supporting quote, OR reports the paper silent. Range domains live in domains.yaml and are enforced downstream.

value.description: The integer value, or null when answered=false.

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the value; required when answered=true.
